faq.question: 什么时候应看 Cookbooks，而不是找 Skill？

faq.question: Skills 是否包含模型权限或账号凭据？

faq.question: 公开示例是否都能直接用于生产？
faq.answer: 不能。示例主要用于展示方法，仓库许可证也不能证明它适合生产。采用前应检查假设、依赖、错误处理和数据要求是否符合自己的应用。

overview.title: 关于 Anthropic

overview.title: About HeyGen
paragraphs: HeyGen develops AI video products for turning ideas, scripts, and visual material into video content. Its product ecosystem includes avatar-based creation, a video agent, and editing tools, while its public developer repositories expose additional ways to build video workflows. Understanding HeyGen therefore involves both the hosted creation service and the tools developers can use around it.

Script, source assets, scene timing, and output requirements help determine whether a hosted video request or an HTML-based rendering project is the better starting point. Keep installation instructions and account requirements tied to the chosen tool, then review the resulting video for message, timing, and visual consistency.

faq.question: What does Matt Pocock’s work cover beyond Skills?
faq.answer: The projects highlighted here include TypeScript-oriented tooling and coding-agent orchestration. Sandcastle concerns running sandboxed agents; ts-reset concerns the types exposed by common JavaScript APIs.

faq.question: When is ts-reset relevant to a TypeScript project?
faq.answer: Look at ts-reset when default library types for common JavaScript APIs are getting in the way of the checks you expect. Review the affected declarations and compatibility notes first; it is not a replacement for a coherent application type model.

faq.question: Does ts-reset change JavaScript runtime behavior?
faq.answer: Its role is to adjust TypeScript type definitions. A type-level change should not be treated as a runtime polyfill; code still needs to be tested against the JavaScript environment where it will execute.

faq.question: Is Sandcastle the same resource as the Skills library?
faq.answer: No. Sandcastle is a TypeScript project for orchestrating sandboxed coding agents. The Skills library provides instructions. Setting up the orchestration software and selecting instructions are separate decisions.

faq.question: What should a planning or engineering Skill receive as context?
faq.answer: Provide the goal, existing constraints, relevant files, and the decisions that are still open. A useful engineering discussion depends more on those specifics than on asking an agent for a generic best-practice checklist.

faq.question: Where are the current setup and contribution instructions?
faq.answer: Use Matt Pocock’s linked project repositories. Read each README and contribution guide separately, because ts-reset, Sandcastle, and the Skills collection have different installation paths and purposes.

faq.question: Can I copy a visual example without checking behavior?

Within this collection, Azure Skills packages cloud workflows for coding agents. Its instructions help route work through preparation, validation, deployment, diagnostics, and platform services. faq.question: How are Azure Skills different from Azure MCP tools?
faq.answer: Skills describe a workflow and the decisions an agent should make. MCP tools expose operations against services. The Azure Skills plugin combines both layers, so useful instructions and working tool access have separate responsibilities.

faq.question: Which Skill should I use before deploying an application?
faq.answer: Start with azure-prepare to prepare the application and deployment files. Use azure-validate to check prerequisites before azure-deploy executes the deployment. These stages make the intended changes and required environment easier to inspect.

faq.question: When is azure-diagnostics useful?
faq.answer: Use it when an existing Azure workload has a production problem. Its workflow investigates symptoms, resource health, logs, metrics, and recent changes, rather than starting by generating a new deployment.

faq.question: Does installing an Azure Skill create a subscription or grant access?
faq.answer: No. Instructions do not create an Azure subscription or confer resource permissions. The tools need a configured identity and the access required for the target subscription, resource group, or service.

faq.question: Is the vscode repository identical to the installed Visual Studio Code distribution?
faq.answer: The repository contains the Code - OSS source project. The Visual Studio Code distribution includes Microsoft-specific branding and distribution customizations; consult the repository explanation when building or redistributing it.

faq.question: Where does TypeScript fit into Azure development?
faq.answer: TypeScript adds type checking and tooling to JavaScript development. It can support application code regardless of hosting provider; it does not itself deploy an application or replace Azure infrastructure configuration.

faq.question: 部署应用之前应该先使用哪个 Skill？

faq.question: azure-diagnostics 适合什么场景？

faq.question: 安装 Azure Skill 会自动创建订阅或获得权限吗？

faq.question: vscode 仓库与安装的 Visual Studio Code 完全相同吗？

faq.question: TypeScript 在 Azure 开发中有什么作用？
faq.answer: TypeScript 为 JavaScript 开发增加类型检查和工具支持，与应用最终使用哪个云平台没有绑定关系。它可以帮助开发应用代码，但不负责部署应用或替代 Azure 基础设施配置。

faq.question: What is the relationship between open.feishu.cn and larksuite/cli?
faq.answer: open.feishu.cn is the Feishu Open Platform domain and a distribution source for the Skills. larksuite/cli is the official CLI repository. Official documentation offers both domain-based and GitHub installation routes for this connected tool ecosystem.

faq.question: Does adding a Feishu Skill install and authorize the CLI?
faq.answer: A Skill provides instructions. The CLI must also be available, configured, and authenticated before it can access the workspace. The official setup guide brings those steps together, but copying an instruction file alone does not complete them.

faq.question: When should I use a user identity instead of a bot identity?
faq.answer: Use the identity supported by the specific command and task. User access follows the authorized person and resource permissions; bot access follows the application permissions and access granted to the bot. They are separate paths rather than interchangeable credentials.

faq.question: How is lark-base different from lark-sheets?
faq.answer: lark-base targets structured Base data such as tables, fields, records, and views. lark-sheets targets spreadsheet data and ranges. Choose the Skill according to the resource you are editing, even if both resources look tabular.

faq.question: Are lark-minutes, lark-vc, and lark-note separate meeting products?
faq.answer: The researched domain collection marks these names as compatibility entries that route to lark-meeting. They should not be counted as separate meeting capabilities; follow the current meeting instructions when maintaining a workflow.

faq.question: What does the standup report workflow combine?
faq.answer: It combines calendar schedules with unfinished tasks to prepare a planning or standup summary. The workflow needs the relevant calendar and task access, and its output reflects the information available to the authorized user.

overview.title: About Remotion
paragraphs: Remotion builds tools for creating videos and motion graphics with React. Instead of treating a finished video as the only artifact, its approach keeps compositions, timing, assets, and parameters in a codebase that developers can edit, reuse, and connect to applications.

Its ecosystem covers several stages of video production. Studio provides an interactive preview, rendering produces a video or still image, Player embeds compositions in a React application, and Lambda supports rendering on AWS. These tools share a composition model but solve different parts of a production or product workflow.

Remotion Agent Skills help coding agents work within this environment, with instructions for creating projects, writing visual markup, looking up documentation, and rendering outputs. They complement the framework rather than replacing it. The software also has its own licensing model, so commercial adoption should follow the official license terms for the intended use.

faq.question: What is the difference between Remotion and its Agent Skills?
faq.answer: Remotion is the software used to build and render React-based videos. Its Skills are instructions that teach coding agents how to work with that software. Installing the instructions does not replace the project dependencies or rendering environment.

faq.question: Should I start with remotion-best-practices or a focused Skill?
faq.answer: The official collection describes remotion-best-practices as the broad entry that encompasses the other Skills. A focused entry such as remotion-create or remotion-render is useful when you already know the stage of work you need.

faq.question: How are Studio and rendering different?
faq.answer: Studio lets you inspect and interact with a composition while developing it. Rendering creates an output file, such as a video or still image. A successful preview is useful during development but is a different step from producing the final artifact.

faq.question: Can Remotion videos be embedded inside a React application?
faq.answer: Yes. Remotion Player embeds compositions in a React app and allows content to be customized at runtime. This supports interactive or personalized video experiences without requiring every parameter change to be a separately exported file.

faq.question: Does Remotion require AWS Lambda for video creation?
faq.answer: No. Lambda is one rendering option for AWS-based workloads. Remotion also documents local and other rendering workflows; choose the execution environment according to your application, output volume, and operational needs.

faq.question: Is Remotion free for every company and every use?
faq.answer: No. The official site distinguishes free-license eligibility from paid company licensing. Source availability and GitHub access do not imply unlimited free use; check the current license and terms for your organization and project.

faq.question: Does a security-audit report establish that an application is safe?
faq.answer: No. Its records distinguish confirmed findings, unresolved candidates, and rejected leads within the work performed. Coverage records and validation evidence help readers assess that work, but do not establish the absence of every vulnerability.

faq.question: What changes between guidance mode and full audit mode?
faq.answer: Guidance mode addresses a security question or focused investigation. Full audit mode uses the multi-phase workflow and produces the defined report artifacts when a complete audit or those artifacts are explicitly requested.

faq.question: How is the Agents SDK Skill different from the SDK itself?
faq.answer: The Skill helps an agent find documentation and implement or review an application. The agents software package supplies runtime classes and APIs. The instruction file does not replace the SDK dependency or the platform configuration.

faq.question: When is the Durable Objects Skill useful?
faq.answer: Use it for applications needing persistent state and coordination, such as rooms, sessions, scheduling, or WebSocket services. It covers implementation and review concerns including RPC methods, alarms, bindings, and storage design.

faq.question: Should every new Cloudflare project use the Wrangler Skill?
faq.answer: The current instruction targets existing Wrangler configuration or an explicit Wrangler request. It routes new or differently configured projects toward the appropriate Cloudflare CLI guidance, so first inspect the project configuration.

overview.title: About Trail of Bits
paragraphs: Trail of Bits is a security research and engineering organization whose public work includes assessments, technical research, educational resources, and software tools. Its projects address different parts of software assurance, from understanding complex code to finding concrete failures and documenting how a finding can be reproduced.

The Skills collection organizes AI-assisted workflows such as audit context building, differential review, and property-based testing. These instructions separate understanding a system from judging a vulnerability, and encourage explicit evidence for the work performed. They are methods for guiding an agent, rather than executable replacements for an analysis tool.

Independent software projects include Slither and Echidna in the Crytic blockchain-security organization, which Trail of Bits identifies as part of its public work. The Skills repository uses CC-BY-SA-4.0; individual software projects have their own licenses and installation requirements.

faq.question: Why does audit-context-building come before vulnerability hunting?
faq.answer: It maps what functions assume, guarantee, and depend on, while keeping unresolved questions visible. Its stated role is understanding the system; it deliberately leaves vulnerability judgments and severity ratings to later investigation.

faq.question: What input does differential-review need?
faq.answer: A change set such as a pull request, commit, or diff, together with repository context. The workflow considers history, callers affected by the change, tests, and potential security consequences rather than reviewing only isolated changed lines.

faq.question: How does property-based testing differ from a list of example tests?
faq.answer: It expresses a rule over an input domain and generates cases that may break that rule. The selected Skill emphasizes meaningful properties and counterexample analysis, including the possibility that a failed test reflects a wrong property rather than a product defect.

faq.question: Do Slither and Echidna perform the same analysis?
faq.answer: No. Slither statically analyzes Solidity and Vyper code and provides detectors and code information. Echidna executes generated transaction sequences to search for violations of contract properties. Their approaches can provide different evidence about the same system.

faq.question: Why do Slither and Echidna use the crytic organization?
faq.answer: Trail of Bits identifies Crytic as its blockchain-security group. These projects live in that related organization, while the Agent Skills repository is under trailofbits. Repository location should be preserved rather than inventing duplicate project URLs.

faq.question: What license applies to the Trail of Bits Skills collection?
faq.answer: The repository identifies CC-BY-SA-4.0. Attribution and share-alike requirements should be checked when reusing its material. This does not set the license for every Trail of Bits software project; each repository supplies its own terms.

faq.question: How does a Skill differ from other Copilot customization files?
faq.answer: A Skill packages task-specific instructions and may include supporting resources. The collection also contains other customization formats with different roles, so a custom agent, reusable instruction, and software integration should not be treated as interchangeable entries.

faq.question: Does the git-commit Skill push changes or open a pull request?
faq.answer: Its current instructions focus on examining the diff, staging related changes, and creating a commit. They explicitly separate that task from pushing, opening pull requests, rebasing, or changing existing commit history.

faq.question: When is the refactor Skill a better fit than a rewrite?
faq.answer: It targets focused improvements to existing code while preserving external behavior. Small steps and tests support gradual structural changes; a new feature or wholesale replacement has a different objective and needs its own scope.

faq.question: Do GitHub CLI and the GitHub MCP Server replace Git?
faq.answer: They provide interfaces to GitHub workflows and platform operations. Git remains the version-control system used by repositories. Installing a platform integration is distinct from setting up the version-control tools needed by the local development workflow.

faq.question: Does installing a Skill grant access to private repositories?
faq.answer: No. Access depends on the authenticated client or integration, its permission scopes, and the user’s repository rights. An instruction file alone does not supply credentials or change organization access controls.

The googleworkspace GitHub organization publishes development resources, including the gws command-line project. gws derives its command surface from Google’s Discovery Service and returns structured output, giving scripts and agents a way to work across services without building a separate command interface for each API.

faq.question: How is Google Workspace different from the gws CLI?
faq.answer: Google Workspace is the suite of collaboration services and their APIs. gws is a command-line project that accesses those APIs, with its own releases, setup, and project status.

faq.question: Is gws an officially supported Google product?
faq.answer: No. The repository explicitly says it is not an officially supported Google product. Publishing under googleworkspace does not remove that project-specific disclaimer.

faq.question: Does installing a gws Skill grant access to my files or mail?
faq.answer: No. Skills provide instructions. Actual access depends on the CLI’s credentials, requested authorization scopes, the signed-in account, and any applicable organization policies.

faq.question: Why are gws commands generated dynamically?
faq.answer: The CLI reads Google API Discovery documents to construct resource and method commands. Its available interface can therefore follow changes to the underlying API descriptions.

faq.question: Should a spreadsheet task use gws-sheets or gws-drive?
faq.answer: Use gws-sheets for spreadsheet content and cell operations. Drive handles files, folders, and sharing resources; some workflows involve both services for different steps.

faq.question: Can I preview a gws request before it runs?
faq.answer: The CLI documents a --dry-run option for previewing requests. A preview helps inspect the intended call; it does not confirm that a later operation succeeded.

faq.question: How are search, scrape, and crawl different in Firecrawl?
faq.answer: Search discovers relevant sources, scrape reads a selected page, and crawl gathers linked pages within a site or section. Choose according to whether you need discovery, one source, or a bounded collection.

faq.question: When is browser interaction useful after scraping?
faq.answer: Use it when a page needs clicks, form input, navigation, or scrolling to expose the requested content. The interaction Skill starts from a previously scraped page and its browser session.

faq.question: Is Firecrawl CLI the same as the Firecrawl platform?
faq.answer: No. The CLI is a terminal client for Firecrawl workflows. The platform supplies the underlying web-data capabilities; installing the client does not reproduce the entire service locally.

faq.question: What can Firecrawl return besides raw HTML?
faq.answer: The platform documents Markdown, structured JSON, screenshots, and other formats. Choose an output that preserves the information your downstream application or research task actually needs.

faq.question: Does the AGPL license describe hosted service usage?
faq.answer: The main repository’s AGPL-3.0 license governs that code. Hosted service terms, access, and usage are separate; evaluate the software license and service arrangement for your chosen setup.

faq.question: How can I keep a site crawl focused?
faq.answer: Set the target section, include-path rules, and page or depth limits. Inspect the completed output to confirm the expected pages were captured instead of assuming that starting a job means it finished.

overview.title: About Supabase
paragraphs: Supabase builds a development platform around Postgres, bringing together database access, authentication, storage, APIs, functions, and realtime features. Its approach gives application developers an integrated backend while keeping the database and surrounding open-source tools visible as distinct technical components.

The ecosystem includes the main platform, client integrations, and a CLI for local development and database workflows. A hosted project provides a managed starting point, while self-hosting and local development offer other operating models. These options share concepts but have different setup and maintenance responsibilities.

The official Supabase Agent Skills repository supplies instructions for working with this ecosystem. The Skill repository is MIT-licensed, separate from the licenses of other software components and the terms of hosted services.

faq.question: Is Supabase only a hosted Postgres database?
faq.answer: Postgres is the foundation, but the platform also integrates authentication, storage, APIs, functions, and realtime capabilities. You can use the parts that fit your application.

faq.question: Which Supabase Skill should I use for a SQL or schema task?
faq.answer: supabase-postgres-best-practices addresses database work including SQL, migrations, indexes, connections, and security. The broader supabase Skill adds platform integration and troubleshooting context.

faq.question: Does the Postgres Skill apply outside Supabase?
faq.answer: Yes. Its published scope includes Postgres running anywhere, although an application’s actual configuration and workload still determine which recommendations fit.

faq.question: What is the role of the Supabase CLI?
faq.answer: It supports local development, database migrations, type generation, and function deployment. It is execution tooling; Skills provide instructions for making and checking the surrounding changes.

faq.question: Does enabling an API replace row-level security?
faq.answer: No. API or table access determines whether a role can reach a resource, while row-level security controls which rows are accessible. Both must match the application’s intended access model.

faq.question: Are local development and self-hosting the same commitment?
faq.answer: No. Local development supports building and testing an application. Operating a self-hosted deployment also requires maintaining the infrastructure, configuration, updates, and service environment.

faq.question: Supabase 只是托管 Postgres 数据库吗？
faq.answer: Postgres 是基础，但平台还整合认证、存储、API、函数和实时能力，可以根据应用需要选择对应部分。

faq.question: SQL 或数据库结构任务应该用哪个 Supabase Skill？
faq.answer: supabase-postgres-best-practices 处理 SQL、迁移、索引、连接和安全等数据库工作；综合 supabase Skill 则补充平台集成与问题排查语境。

faq.question: Postgres Skill 能用于 Supabase 之外的数据库吗？
faq.answer: 可以。其公开范围包括运行在其他环境中的 Postgres，但具体建议仍需要结合实际配置与应用负载判断。

faq.question: Supabase CLI 在开发中承担什么角色？
faq.answer: 它支持本地开发、数据库迁移、类型生成和函数部署，属于执行工具；Skills 则指导如何组织这些变更并检查结果。

faq.question: 启用 API 就不需要行级安全了吗？
faq.answer: 不是。API 或表访问决定角色能否触达资源，行级安全决定能够访问哪些数据行，两者都需要符合应用预期的权限模型。

faq.question: 本地开发和自托管需要承担相同维护工作吗？
faq.answer: 不相同。本地开发主要服务于应用构建和测试，自托管运行还需要维护基础设施、配置、更新和服务环境。
